_comment: sim-release-open-reissue-v1 (coldwin84). Purpose: make the contact-gated weld RELEASE at the cart set-down DETERMINISTIC so the run no longer e-stops with the carton still welded. coldwin84 was a BYTE-IDENTICAL re-run of the cleanly-released coldwin83 that HUNG at the set-down: the contact-gated release fired, the release phase emitted the gripper-open control ONCE (controller.py release phase, self.issued latch), but the Isaac side NEVER ran cad_tool.command(open) -- coldwin84.console.log has ZERO 'SEAL_DIAG command:open' lines (the last SEAL_DIAG is still 'command:close ... enabled=True', inst c610) while coldwin83.console.log has exactly ONE. The single open-carrying /manipulation/status was overwritten on the LAST-VALUE control relay (control_ipc keeps only the latest status per topic) by a newer, no-control release tick's higher sequence before IsaacRosGraph.poll read it -- the SAME one-shot drop PR 356 fixed for the contact ENABLE. The SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK weld therefore never released and the run e-stopped: HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=release 'release did not detach the held carton within 8.0s sim of the gripper-open command' (coldwin84/host-stack.log line 24460). Five earlier runs on the identical config released cleanly -- the release was a dice roll on relay timing. Absent/off => the single-shot open + the 8 s release_detach_timeout_s path => byte-identical.
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by ros_host.py -> TransferController). These keys live UNDER the existing carton_level block (parsed by carton_level.resolve_level_config, validated by LevelConfig.validate -- a typo fails loudly at boot; no new config_preflight registration).

carton_level._existing: Keep the run's existing carton_level keys (place_contact_release / place_release_on_contact, place_contact_gap_m, closed_loop_*, place_from_above, release_cancel_handshake, etc). Only the three keys below are added by this change.
carton_level._release_reissue_note: Opt-in master switch. When on, the release phase RE-EMITS the gripper-open control -- which on the Isaac side is BOTH the open AND the SIM_ATTACH_FALLBACK weld detach (cad_tool.command(False) -> open_gripper + _release_fallback) -- on EVERY release tick until the per-tick feedback confirms the gripper OPEN and the carton NOT held (seal released), THEN proceeds to the cuMotion planning-scene detach (update_payload, issued ONCE from the confirmed-released state). Every release status then carries controls=[open], so whichever one the last-value relay hands IsaacRosGraph.poll lands the open -- the relay can no longer drop it. Off/absent => the legacy single-shot open (reproduces the cw84 dice roll). Logs RELEASE_REISSUE n=.. once per release_reissue_log_every ticks and RELEASE_CONFIRMED with the tick count when it detaches.
carton_level._release_confirm_timeout_s_note: SIM seconds. The bounded window (from the FIRST gripper-open) for the re-issued release to confirm. If the feedback never confirms gripper-open + carton-not-held within it, the release FAILS BY NAME -- HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=release 'RELEASE_NOT_CONFIRMED: gripper-open + weld-detach re-issued every tick for N tick(s) / <t>s sim but the feedback never confirmed ... not restarting the stage with the carton welded' -- with the held / gripper_open / status_fresh fields, NEVER a blind restart with the carton still welded. Clamped under the per-phase timeout. 8.0 s matches the prior release_detach_timeout_s budget; the re-emit normally lands the open and confirms within a couple of render-paced Isaac poll cycles.
carton_level._release_reissue_log_every_note: Emit one RELEASE_REISSUE line per this many release ticks (the first line is n=1), so a slow-landing open is visible without flooding the host-stack log during the render-paced release window.

_requires: RESTOCK_CONTACT_STATUS_FEEDBACK=1 in BOTH the Isaac and host process environments (PR 358): the confirmation reads the per-tick gripper feedback (gripper_enabled + gripper_status_time) the host-facing /sensors capture carries. coldwin84 already set it. Without it the gate still confirms on the physical seal-released signal alone (s.contact clearing) -- the feedback cannot contradict -- but the gripper-open corroboration is unavailable. The HOST carton_level block must already carry the contact-gated release (place_release_on_contact:true OR place_contact_release:true) that FIRES the release at the set-down and, for the cart set-down, release_cancel_handshake:true; this change only hardens what the release does AFTER the gripper-open is requested.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the cw84 config (the full cold restock cycle through the collect cart set-down) through scripts/run_mobile_restock.py under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr), with release_reissue:true merged into the HOST carton_level block and RESTOCK_CONTACT_STATUS_FEEDBACK=1 in both processes. Expected PASS (coldwin85): the welded carton descends level onto the cart shelf, the stall-triggered release fires exactly as cw84, the cancel-handshake settles, then the gripper-open is RE-EMITTED every tick (RELEASE_REISSUE n=..) until the Isaac side runs cad_tool.command(open) -- the console now shows >=1 'SEAL_DIAG command:open' (cw84 had ZERO) -- the weld releases, RELEASE_CONFIRMED logs the tick count, the cuMotion detach acks, and the run advances to retreat/stow/verify -- NO HOST_FAULT_ESTOP phase=release with the carton welded. If the open genuinely never lands within release_confirm_timeout_s, the release fails fast by name (RELEASE_NOT_CONFIRMED) rather than the opaque 8 s never-detach e-stop.
